remarks: This one-of-a-kind home boasts a tranquil and private setting surrounded by natural beauty, reminiscent of a home you might find on the outskirts of village in the English of French countryside. Lovingly cared for, updated, and expanded by the owners, the property features a two-story barn built in 2017 with an adjoining covered patio, offering ample space for various activities or entertaining.   This retreat-like home offers a haven for those seeking respite from the hustle of city life or local neighbors looking to downsize to a unique and relaxing environment. Ideal for first-time homebuyers eager to establish roots in Wilton, this house embodies charm and tranquility that must be seen to be fully appreciated. With its blend of natural beauty, thoughtful design, and inviting spaces, it promises a lifestyle of serenity and contentment for its fortunate occupants.
